question: Do local responses to exemplar removal support protected instance correction beyond fusion and matched verification?
authorization: Owner October29: proceed with next bounded pilot and finish training/experiment; a passing pilot is not automatic full-counter or publication authority.
group_policy: Disjoint category components linked by exact-image hashes; source-training base-model exposure disclosed. Earlier diagnostic/selection rows excluded from decision.
scale: All four responses use native full-three image tensor/scale; no new crops or changes to native postprocess.
pretrained_weights: Frozen existing verified GeCo2 and SAM2; no new download.
features: ROI means from all three native frozen SAM2 FPN levels; fixed unfitted orthogonal projections, exemplar cosines, geometry, native confidence. Correction substitutes 16 response descriptors for 16 local descriptors.

association.anchor: First response member, never transitive moving centroid
association.method: Maximum-cardinality then minimum cost assignment, at most one member per response

label_semantics: Per-response one-to-one point-proximity assignments within max(2px, half median supplied-exemplar side); unmatched near-point proposals ignored; far proposals are point-location negatives, not object-mask truth.
objective: Same unweighted BCE on valid per-proposal point-assignment targets, mean within each image then across batch. No new V11-loss experiment or inference GT.
feature_standardization: Fitting images only; std floor0.05 and clip[-10,10], same procedure both arms.
endpoint: Mean absolute error over fixed decision images averaged across three seeds; not a count ensemble.
calibration: Report-only group check; no threshold/coefficient/model selection. Does not enter fit statistics.
limits: Point proximity is not instance AP; consumed stress is not independent extremes; base may have seen FSC training. No novelty/acceptance established by a pass.
failure_policy: Stop on incomplete stage, integrity, finite/replay, memory/disk or timeout failure; no retry or extra fit; preserve all outputs.
